title: Connect Digital Fashion Marketplace & Gallery - Buy, Sell, Share Assets
description:
CONNECT is an open marketplace where you can download and buy Marvelous Designer / CLO assets, as well as find a community of fellow designers. 
Whether you're looking for inspiration, resources, or collaboration opportunities, CONNECT is your go-to platform.

🌐 Start exploring now: connect.clo-set.com

markdown_content: ## Introduction to Connect Digital Fashion Marketplace & Gallery This section introduces the Connect Digital Fashion platform, focusing on its role as a marketplace and gallery for buying, selling, and sharing digital fashion assets. Key terminology includes digital fashion, marketplace, gallery, and asset sharing. ## Platform Overview and Features Connect Digital Fashion Marketplace & Gallery is designed to facilitate transactions of digital fashion items. Users can browse a curated collection of digital garments and accessories, purchase them using supported payment methods, and share their collections within the community. The platform supports various digital asset formats and integrates with popular 3D modeling and virtual reality environments, enabling seamless import and export of fashion items. ## Buying and Selling Digital Fashion Assets This section details the procedures for buying and selling digital fashion assets on the platform. Sellers can list their digital garments by uploading compatible 3D files, setting prices, and providing descriptions. Buyers can filter items by categories, designers, or price ranges and complete purchases securely. The marketplace supports escrow services and offers transaction history tracking. Additionally, it includes features for bidding and auctions to facilitate competitive sales. ## Asset Sharing and Community Interaction Connect allows users to share their digital fashion collections through virtual galleries and social feeds. Community features include commenting, rating, and collaborative design workshops. Users can showcase their assets in virtual showrooms linked to their profiles, promoting visibility and networking opportunities within the digital fashion ecosystem. ## Technical Specifications and Supported Formats The platform supports a range of technical specifications critical for digital fashion assets. Supported 3D file formats include OBJ, FBX, and GLTF, with detailed guidelines for polygon count, texture resolution, and animation compatibility. Connect integrates with software like Blender, Marvelous Designer, and Unity, enabling designers to create and export assets directly to the marketplace. ## Security and Limitations Security protocols include encrypted transactions, user authentication via two-factor authentication (2FA), and digital rights management (DRM) to protect creators' intellectual property. Limitations include file size restrictions (up to 500 MB per asset), supported blockchain networks for NFT-based transactions, and geographic availability constraints due to regulatory compliance. ## Summary Connect Digital Fashion Marketplace & Gallery offers a comprehensive platform for digital fashion asset trading, combining marketplace functionality, community engagement, and technical integration with leading design tools. It supports secure transactions, diverse asset formats, and interactive sharing features, positioning itself as a key player in the digital fashion ecosystem.
